intelligence.enrichment: A food web is formed when food chains in an ecosystem are interlinked and organisms are connected to multiple feeding relationships. When one organism is eaten by two or more types of organisms or is linked through several feeding paths, separate food chains combine into a food web. The learner correctly applies this rule: A food web is formed when food chains in an ecosystem are interlinked and organisms are connected to multiple feeding relationships. Any feeding diagram with arrows is a food web.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Ecosystems and habitats. The student must decide: Decide whether a feeding diagram is a food chain or a food web by checking whether it is one linear path or many interlinked feeding paths. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
